description: Records match the data contract schema and types (Pandera)
Credits are integers in 1..16 (0 only where rules.json states 0; ug_background excluded)
examples: [{"id": "tt-r64", "code": "CS 329", "credits": 4.0, "problem": "type float, not int"}, {"id": "tt-r66", "code": "ES 678", "credits": 4.0, "problem": "type float, not int"}, {"id": "tt-r113", "code": "CS 329", "credits": 4.0, "problem": "type float, not int"}, {"id": "tt-r181", "code": "FP 601", "credits": 2.0, "problem": "type float, not int"}, {"id": "tt-r185", "code": "PE 600", "credits": 0.0, "problem": "type float, not int"}, {"id": "tt-r212", "code": "ES 621", "credits": 4.0, "problem": "type float, not int"}, {"id": "tt-r236", "code": "ES 604", "credits": 4.0, "problem": "type float, not int"}, {"id": "tt-r237", "code": "ES 662", "credits": 4.0, "problem": "type float, not int"}]

description: Required fields are not null or empty
No course code appears twice (raw: within one source document)
requirement: spec: no course code appears twice
examples: [{"code": "CS 618", "source": "Revised CSE MTech Course Structure [2025-26].pdf", "ids": ["struct-008", "struct-013"]}, {"code": "CS 329", "source": "Timetable, Sem-I, 2026-27.xlsx", "ids": ["tt-r113", "tt-r64"]}, {"code": "ES 621", "source": "Timetable, Sem-I, 2026-27.xlsx", "ids": ["tt-r212", "tt-r291"]}, {"code": "ES 666", "source": "Timetable, Sem-I, 2026-27.xlsx", "ids": ["tt-r249", "tt-r279"]}, {"code": "FP 602", "source": "Timetable, Sem-I, 2026-27.xlsx", "ids": ["tt-r400", "tt-r401", "tt-r402", "tt-r403"]}]

description: No exact duplicate records (all content fields equal, provenance ignored)
Course titles agree with the timetable title for the same code (catches typos like 'Algrithms')
requirement: general: spelling / title consistency against timetable
examples: [{"id": "struct-003", "code": "CS 613", "title": "NLP", "timetable_title": "Natural Language Processing", "ratio": 20.0, "kind": "different wording or abbreviation"}, {"id": "struct-020", "code": "CS 614", "title": "Advanced Algrithms", "timetable_title": "Advanced Algorithms", "ratio": 97.3, "kind": "typo"}, {"id": "ee-power-04", "code": "EE 648", "title": "Dynamic Behaviour of Electric Machinery", "timetable_title": "Dynamic Behaviour of Electric Machines", "ratio": 96.1, "kind": "typo"}, {"id": "ee-signal-20", "code": "ES 675", "title": "Photonics - Principles and Applications", "timetable_title": "Photonics – Principles and Applications", "ratio": 97.4, "kind": "typo"}, {"id": "ee-integrated-05", "code": "EE 651", "title": "Analog CMOS IC Design", "timetable_title": "CMOS Analog IC Design", "ratio": 76.2, "kind": "different wording or abbreviation"}]

description: Titles have no leading/trailing whitespace, double spaces or trailing punctuation
examples: [{"id": "struct-012", "title": "Artificial Intelligence,"}, {"id": "struct-022", "title": "Nature-inspired computing,"}, {"id": "tt-r248", "title": "Incentives and Machine learning "}, {"id": "tt-r395", "title": "NeuroAI: Neuroscience & Artificial Intelligence "}]

description: No two different codes have near-duplicate titles (rapidfuzz token_sort_ratio >= 92)
requirement: general: near-duplicate titles (warning, needs human review)
examples: [{"codes": ["ES 678", "ES 654"], "titles": ["Machine Learning", "Machine Learning"], "ratio": 100.0}, {"codes": ["ES 417", "ES 668"], "titles": ["5G and Beyond", "5G and Beyond"], "ratio": 100.0}]
note: warning only: cross-listed UG/PG or special-topics versions can share a title

description: Course credits and L-T-P agree with the timetable row where both exist
requirement: spec: course credits agree with timetable L-T-P-C
